related.title: 巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島
related.titleEn: Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦APR1400 首堆：二迴路四冷段佈置、安全注入槽流體裝置與品保文件事件；巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島則以50 Hz 版 APR1400 的半速汽輪機島、發電機冷卻與高溫海水凝汽器為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first APR1400: two loops with four cold legs, the fluidic device in the safety injection tanks and the quality-document affair; Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island centres on the half-speed turbine island of the 50 Hz APR1400, generator cooling and a condenser for hot seawater, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「冷卻劑流量與爐心溫升」的模型移到巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「大型機組的慣量與跳機衝擊」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Coolant flow and core temperature rise" to Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Inertia of large units and the impact of a trip", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；巴拉卡核電站汽輪機島的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Barakah Nuclear Power Plant Turbine Island must be respecified.

related.title: AP1000 壓水式發電架構
related.transfer: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；AP1000 壓水式發電架構的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦APR1400 首堆：二迴路四冷段佈置、安全注入槽流體裝置與品保文件事件；AP1000 壓水式發電架構則以非能動安全、屏蔽馬達泵與結構模組化的定量檢核為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the first APR1400: two loops with four cold legs, the fluidic device in the safety injection tanks and the quality-document affair; AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture centres on quantitative checks of passive safety, canned-motor pumps and structural modules, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」與「熱功率、電功率與淨效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「冷卻劑流量與爐心溫升」的模型移到AP1000 壓水式發電架構，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency" and "Thermal power, electrical power and net efficiency".
Move the model of "Coolant flow and core temperature rise" to AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「年發電量與容量因數」與「儀控表決邏輯與可靠度」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；AP1000 壓水式發電架構的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Voting logic and reliability of instrumentation and control" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 新古里 3 號 APR1400 機組
history.text: 2008 年工程開工；2013 年發現電纜檢驗文件造假並決定更換；2016 年併網並商轉；2019 年取得美國設計認證。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2008: Construction began. 2013: Falsified cable certificates were found and replacement ordered. 2016: Grid connection and commercial operation. 2019: US design certification was granted. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
